mapper.insert: INSERT INTO one_time_link_flow ( grant_hash, exchange_owner_hash, purpose, source_token_hash, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{grantHash}, #{exchangeOwnerHash}, #{purpose}, #{sourceTokenHash}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{lifetimeSeconds} SECOND) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expires_at = IF(consume_claim_hash IS NULL, VALUES(expires_at), expires_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM one_time_link_flow WHERE expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() AND ( consume_claim_hash IS NULL OR consume_claimed_at < DATE_SUB( UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL #{abandonedClaimSeconds} SECOND) )
